# D3 for the problem map

`d3.min.js` is the unmodified D3 7.9.0 browser bundle, downloaded from
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/dist/d3.min.js on 12 September 2026.
SHA-256: `f2094bbf6141b359722c4fe454eb6c4b0f0e42cc10cc7af921fc158fceb86539`.

Upstream: https://github.com/d3/d3/tree/v7.9.0
License: ISC, included in `LICENSE.d3` from that release.
Documentation: https://d3js.org/d3-force and https://d3js.org/d3-zoom.

The map serves this file locally and does not require a CDN or package registry
at runtime. Catalogue summaries remain in the existing generated `data.js`.
